data.name: Hotel Antumalal
data.address: Camino Pucón a Villarrica, Km.2, 4920000 Pucon, Pucón, Araucanía, Chile
data.description:
Overlooking Villarrica Lake, this serene hotel with Bauhaus-inspired architecture is 3 km from Pucón town center and a 34 km drive from Villarrica National Park.
The cozy rooms have wood-paneled walls and feature Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, fireplaces and lake views. Suites add living/dining rooms, and there are also rustic or woodsy-chic chalets with terraces.
There’s a breakfast buffet, and a restaurant with a deck and panoramic lake views. Other amenities include a garden with a beach, a dock and a tennis court. There's also a spa with both a heated indoor and an outdoor pool, plus a sauna and a hot tub.
